args.title: Tutorial Creator
args.description: Narrated walkthrough videos, recorded by an agent

args.text: This is the Tutorial Creator, a server that records narrated walkthrough videos of web applications.
An agent drives a browser that is already signed in, speaks over what it is doing, and returns a finished video.
The browser it records is invisible, so recordings run in the background and your machine stays usable.
Each line of narration is generated before it is spoken, and the recording waits for exactly as long as the speech takes. Picture and sound cannot drift apart.
To record an application you are logged into, you sign in once. The session is then reused by every later recording.
Keeping secrets out of the video
Passwords and verification codes can be marked as sensitive, so they are never captioned on screen.

steps.comment: The section this scrolls to is the one it is describing.

args.text: That is the whole idea. Ask for a tutorial in plain language, and get back a video you can share.
